name: Misono Misono
source:
A maid for the Tenjou family. Due to the trademark poker face she carries, it is very difficult to read her emotions and feelings but she is embarrassed very easly if she has compliments about her work, her beauty or her cuteness.

She is the chief of all the maids who serves the Tenjou family.

[spoiler]When [url=https://vndb.org/c2723]Rio[/url] moves to [url=https://vndb.org/c10154]Yuuto[/url]'s place to deepen her training, she've for mission to help her when [url=https://vndb.org/c2723]Rio[/url] needs.

She is drunk very fast.

Despite beeing more older than the other characters, she has never kiss a man before and she was excited by the view of the lips of [url=https://vndb.org/c10154]Yuuto[/url] when she took care of him after his second collapse.[/spoiler]

She is the chief of all the maids who serves the Tenjou family.

[spoiler]When [url=https://vndb.org/c2723]Rio[/url] moves to [url=https://vndb.org/c10154]Yuuto[/url]'s place to deepen her training, she've for mission to help her when [url=https://vndb.org/c2723]Rio[/url] needs.

She is drunk very fast.

Despite beeing more older than the other characters, she has never kiss a man before and she was excited by the view of the lips of [url=https://vndb.org/c10154]Yuuto[/url] when she took care of him after his second collapse.[/spoiler]
